name: Supabase Inspired
description: Neutral surfaces, subtle borders and emerald accents. An independent concept, not an official Supabase specification.
guidelines: Use semantic CSS variables for colours; keep light and dark modes complete.
Use 14px body text, 24px section headings and 12px captions.
Use 4px spacing increments and 6px control radii.
Use brand fill for primary actions with onBrand text; use surface and border tokens for secondary controls.
Provide visible keyboard focus, associated input labels and explicit loading, empty and error states.
Check text contrast; use text or an accessible darker green for small text on light surfaces.
Use generic reusable buttons, forms, cards and tables. Do not copy DevDeck branding into the project.
Keep design choices independent of permissions and workflow instructions.
